NONE: › If something bad or dangerous befalls you, it happens to you.

example: Should any harm befall me on my journey, you may open this letter.
萬一我這次旅程有甚麼不測，你就拆開這封信。

NONE: › to be suitable or right for someone or something

example: She was buried in the cathedral, as befits someone of her position.
她葬在大教堂墓地，和她的身份很相稱。

NONE: A1 at or during a time earlier than (the thing mentioned)
A2 If a place is before another place, you will arrive at it first when you are travelling towards the second place.
› If something is before someone or before a group of people, it will be formally considered or examined by that person or group.

example: You should always wash your hands before meals.
飯前應該洗手。
Before leaving he said goodbye to each of them.
他離開前向每個人告別。
She's always up before dawn.
她總是在天亮前就起床了。
Before he could reach the door, she quickly closed it.
他還沒走到門前，她就迅速關上了門。
Before we make a decision, does anyone want to say anything else?
趁我們還未作決定，還有人想說甚麼嗎？
She had to give the doorman a tip before he would help her with her suitcases (= he would not do it until she had given him a tip).
她要給看門房小費，讓他幫忙提箱子。
It was an hour before the police arrived.
員警一小時後才趕到。
He said he had never seen her before.
他說他以前從未見過她。
I feel as though I've been here before.
我覺得以前好像曾到過這裡。
The letter K comes before L in the English alphabet.
在英文字母表中，K排在L前面。
Many mothers put their children's needs before their own.
很多母親都把孩子的需要置於自己的需要之前。
We have the whole weekend before us - what do you want to do?
我們有整個週末的時間——做些甚麼呢？
He stood up before a whole roomful of people, and asked her to marry him.
他在滿屋子人面前站起來，向她求婚。
The bus stop is just before the school.
公車站就在學校前面一點。
The proposal before the committee is that we try and reduce our spending by ten percent.
委員會正在考慮我們打算降低10%開支的建議。
The men appeared before the judge yesterday.
這些人昨天出庭了。
They'll be home before very long.
他們很快就要到家了。

NONE: › used to say that something happens very quickly

example: Before you could say Jack Robinson, she'd jumped into the car and driven away.
一眨眼的功夫，她已經跳上汽車開走了。

NONE: 還沒意識到之前（用來表示很快）

example: We'll be on our way out again before you know it.
在你還沒意識到之前，我們就又出去了。

NONE: 瞪著眼；從眼皮底下；從眼前

example: Then, before my very eyes, she disappeared.
接著，她就從我眼皮底下消失了。
I knew she was coming that afternoon because she had phoned beforehand to say so.
我知道她那天下午會來，因為她事先打電話跟我說過。

NONE: › internet & telecoms to make someone your friend on a social networking website
在網路社交平臺上添加某人為好友

example: He was befriended by an old lady.
他得到一位老太太的幫助。
It is not advisable to befriend your boss, or your teacher.
在網路社交平臺上把自己的老闆或者老師添加為好友是不太明智的。

friend
